claims.claim: emergent insects supply 25–100 % of the energy of riparian birds, bats and spiders
claims.note: Full text not read (the paper already flags 'abstract only'). The abstract says emergence of adult insects FROM STREAMS 'contributes 25–100% of the energy or carbon to such species' (birds, bats, lizards, spiders). Two differences from the paper's sentence: the figure is for stream emergence (the paper's paragraph is about lake emergence and gives no such caveat), and it is energy OR carbon. The abstract also notes the flux declines exponentially with distance from the stream edge.
